title: euodia ternata
intro: Euodia ternata, commonly known as Chinese rowan or rowan tree, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to relieve fever, reduce inflammation, and act as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Euodia ternata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, alleviate pain, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Euodia ternata include limonoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries.
